title: AAPS SMB Mode: doesn't work with XDrip anymore - in latest Dev Versions
symptom: In the latest dev versions, XDrip with Dexcom G6 Transmitter in Native Mode is not accepted as BG Source for SMB, causing AAPS to report that SMB is deactivated because the selected BG source doesn't support trusted filtering. The Master version works fine with the same settings.
cause: The issue appears to be a bug in the dev version, as it works in the master version and after a fix, the security notice disappears after a new blood glucose value comes in.
fix: The fix was applied in a dev version, and after the first new blood glucose value comes in, the security notice that SMB was disabled disappeared on the SMB tab.
evidence_quote: At first moment I thought the fix won't help. But after the first new blood glucose value comes in, the security notice that SMB was disabled disappeared on SMB tab.
